text: Wire contract: the same-name merge, clock clamping and the sync input caps are undocumented

Landed. Documents the same-name merge (survivor rule, per-field LWW across the group, server-merge tombstones and what a client can therefore see), clock clamping, the per-field sync caps, and the updated_by exception; corrects the About-screen claim, the protocol-field fiction and the device_label/created_at optionality. Two of my ticket's claims were wrong and the agent caught both: the full_lists 403 was already documented (the T-257 fix added it) and Android does have an unused lists() method, so GET /lists is marked legacy-and-unused-by-both rather than absent on Android.
